Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. Describe what the query computes and the assumptions it makes; the returned rows are reported separately. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. Use DOUBLE or DECIMAL, rather than single-precision REAL, for percentage calculations.

gold_sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id, s.line_end - s.line_start + 1 AS lines
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE s.kind IN ('function', 'method') AND NOT f.is_test
ORDER BY lines DESC, s.symbol_id
LIMIT 1;
